headline: Я ЗНАЛ ПРО
БИТКОИН
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / compositing. Edit the attached ORIGINAL thumbnail image1 into a punchy curiosity-driven YouTube thumbnail for the animated story 'Кассеты'. ONE finished widescreen16:9 illustration, opaque PNG, ideally1280x720.
REFERENCE ROLES: image1 controls main boy Sasha's face, big stunned eyes, open mouth, raised child hand, olive pocket T-shirt, tactile paper medium and general right-side portrait composition. Image2 is Sasha's facial identity: youngest top-left and adult33 bottom-right are the SAME hero at different ages. Image3 age sheet confirms same character: far-left12, far-right33. Image4 controls the old beige CRT computer/keyboard early-2000s design; do not copy its room or person.
MAIN HERO: keep the SAME12-year-old Sasha large on the RIGHT, occupying about50-55% image width, chest up, recognizable high dark-brown spiky cowlick, narrow angular face and big serious brown eyes. Slightly heighten his surprised realization without changing identity: eyes wide, brows lifted, mouth softly open, one child hand raised between him and computer. He has returned to childhood remembering future technology. WHOLE head/cowlick must be at least6% below TOP edge, no hair crop. No extra fingers.
LEFT LOWER: add ONE chunky beige early-2000s CRT monitor on a simple kraft desk, small beige keyboard and partial tower behind, unified as one computer. Computer occupies x=7%..43%,y=43%..85%; make monitor screen large and nearly FRONT-ON so we can place a clear Bitcoin symbol on it later in code. Screen is solid deep desaturated teal with ONE LARGE flat MUSTARD-YELLOW PAPER CIRCLE in its center, about60% of screen height, perfectly BLANK with no glyph at all; this represents the Bitcoin emblem to be completed later. Monitor face clearly visible, avoid extreme perspective; no menus, balances, numbers, text, stock charts or profits. The gold circle should be bold graphic flat paper, not a shiny physical treasure coin.
ADULT SELF: a smaller low-contrast memory portrait behind the computer near x=48%,y=47%, only head and upper chest, clearly secondary and aboutone-third the scale of the boy. This is33-year-old SASHA, NOT his brother: same tall pointed cowlick/narrow eyes/straight nose but more mature angular jaw, subtle beard stubble and tired adult eyes, gray-teal sweater over cream collar as age sheet. Portrait stays below y=34% and above y=73%. Muted cool teal/gray paper, subtly receding behind main boy/computer. It is an editorial memory of the same man, no physical interaction, no supernatural aura. Do not add Kostya or other characters.
HEADLINE SAFE ZONE: keep top LEFT completely blank CREAM, x=5%..54%,y=7%..35%, enough for two very large Russian lines added in code. NO writing anywhere in the generated scene, not even Bitcoin B. Remove the old little calendar to simplify the design. Single focus is Sasha realizing future knowledge, supported by computer and adult memory.
STYLE: EXACT handmade layered colored-paper collage of references, thick matte colored paper, irregular torn/cut edges, visible fibers, expressive stylized paper faces, shallow soft contact shadows. Stronger warm-cream vs deep-teal separation than original; brighter mustard circle provides one dominant accent. Group palette into cream/kraft skin, deep muted teal/olive/brown, mustard yellow. Preserve warm natural face tones. Avoid black outlines, glossy plastic, gold rain, luxury items, photorealism,3D, painting, blur, red, money stacks, rockets, explosions or magical effects.
TRUTH: this is a STORY, he remembers Bitcoin when12 in2005 and later mines it in2009 on a home PC with his brother. This image is a narrative montage of future knowledge, NOT a claim Bitcoin was already mining in2005. No promised earnings, price or invented outcome.
SAFE AREA: all faces, hair, coin emblem and keyboard5% from edges. Quiet lower-right corner x=85%..100%,y=85%..100%, no hand or face there. Do not add arrows/circles around features, labels, watermark, caption, brands or any other lettering.
